JD: wire actualFee / estimateFee are already net, no service-fee deduction; est takes actualFee at validCode 17 and estimateFee otherwise; settle always null (statement import). Taobao: est = pub_share_pre_fee_for_commission − alimm_tech_service_pre_fee, settle = pub_share_fee_for_commission − alimm_tech_service_fee read only at tk_status 3, fee from alimm_share_info_dto with alimama_share_fee fallback. PDD: est = promotion_amount − duo_id_service_fee, settle null. subsidy_commission_fen is not output by any adapter (orders pipeline-port sets null) — written as-is with a TODO, not claimed done. Recordings cited by rebate-private path only (field-shape summaries, nothing copied); check status 未核对 for all three (per-order reconciliation against the union back office needs real orders and owner accounts). Unverified items marked 未实测. No runtime code, migration or test outside test/spec/union/spec-docs changed. Host vitest 36/36 green on the implementation. After the first push CI test-guard failed on the describe() wrapper; fixed mechanically per D10-1235 (see spec_test_review).
